The *Mandāravapupphapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 157) is a biographical poem preserved in the Therāpadāna collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. Like many short apadānas, it recounts the past meritorious deeds and spiritual attainment of an elder therā. SuttaCentral records five translations of the poem across five different languages [SuttaCentral].
